description: Implementation of WindowManagerHandler class and its nested Notification class, managing window manager events and interactions in a plugin environment.

classes.name: WindowManagerHandler
classes.description: Handles window manager interactions, registration, event notifications, and rendering control.

classes.name: WindowManagerHandler::WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class handling specific window manager events such as user inactivity, disconnection, and readiness.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager interface and registers notification callbacks.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Unregisters notification callbacks and releases window manager resources.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Dispatches window manager events to the registered event handler.

methods.name: renderReady
methods.description: Checks if the application instance is ready for rendering.

methods.name: enableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables display rendering for a specific application instance.
